title: Bump zizmor from 1.31.1 to 1.32.0

note:
#1348 review record posted (round 1 PASS, comment 6712012281). Its note: the sentence "1.31.1 passes it" in skills/ci-hygiene/snippets.md:169 is prose no check covers; this step rewrites it.
Waits on #1348's merge (pin to 1.31.1); the coordinator starts its lane then. Pin sites: actions/zizmor/run.sh, actions/zizmor/test_action.sh, lint/test_ci_job.py:1086, skills/ci-hygiene/snippets.md:169.
Rule verification-newest-that-passes: read 1.32.0's changelog first. Pin it if the action checks pass; else keep 1.31.1 and say why. Done: the pin on main with a green run.
